theorems.proof_goal: Show that O* minimizer switching is stable when admissibility is preserved, d_Omega divergence remains bounded or legally recoupled, mismatch-cost change is bounded, and degeneracy boundaries are explicitly handled.
assumptions: A active admissibility window is declared
O=(L,Q) family and L-before-Q precedence are active
d_Omega is available as a pseudometric scaffold
degenerate minimizer sets are preserved as set-valued references unless a tie-break rule is declared

proof_obligations.statement: Show that equivalence-preserving O* switches preserve induced -(i) class under Ref(.).
Show that bounded d_Omega divergence prevents untracked reference discontinuity within a declared admissibility window.
Show that degeneracy-boundary switches remain well-formed when the minimizer set is treated as set-valued.
Show that equivalence-class-changing switches require R_RECOUPLING_V1 or admissibility-window change.
Show that forbidden Q transitions, memoryless reopenings, or residue-as-agent readings invalidate stability.

remaining_gaps: full algebraic proof of O associativity under restricted conditions
